title: FBL NPC Generator
description: Adds an NPC generator button next to the Adventure Site button in the Journal directory. Rolls a random NPC of any kin (or specific) using the typical NPCs and personal quirks tables from the Forbidden Lands GM Guide, plus a random kin-appropriate name from the Players Handbook.

requires.reason: The Adventure Site generator from this module is the host the NPC button docks onto.
